question.text: A regular polygon of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn></math> sides is formed by bending a wire of length <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></math> meter. If an electric current of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mi>π</mi><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> is flowing through the sides of the polygon, the magnetic field at the centre of the polygon would be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is ______.

solution.text:
Direction of magnetic field due to all six sides will be in the same direction, therefore we can write 

B=6μ0I4πrsin30°+sin30°, where r=distance of the sides from the centre.

=610-7×4π3π3×3

=72×10-7 T

Hence, x=72.
